text:
helen: Auditor requested a packaged proof for the RBAC change we made on 2026-03-18 that removed wildcard write on infra S3. Need PR, terraform/apply evidence, RoleBinding manifests, KMS usage events (Encrypt/GenerateDataKey), and log retention config. Can we assemble and sign?

samir: I have the PR + commit and the terraform plan output. PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/ops/pulls/3245. Will export the plan and commit diff to artifacts/infra-rbac/3245/plan.txt and commit.txt.

auditor_jane: Please include a short mapping doc that ties each artifact to SOC2 control(s) and ISO statements. For example: which part of CC6 or A.9.2.1 is demonstrated by the RoleBinding change.

kevin_oncall: For who executed the change: CloudTrail shows the deployment role used by deploy-bot during the stack update. Quick CloudTrail lookup I ran: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=UpdateStack --start-time 2026-03-18T12:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z
```
Result has userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName = "deploy-bot" and sourceIPAddress = "10.2.3.4". I'll export the event JSON (redacted emails) to artifacts/cloudtrail/stack-update-event.json.

samir: Kubernetes RoleBinding snapshots are in artifacts/rolebindings/2026-03-18.yaml (we keep cluster backup archives daily). Command used: `kubectl get rolebinding -n infra-system -o yaml`. I will also include the git history for the manifest to show the change.

helen: KMS events: auditor wants proof that only the service principal svc:redwood-deploy called GenerateDataKey/Encrypt for the DEK. I queried CloudTrail KMS events and found matching entries where requestParameters.keyId = arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-ef01. I'll export two sample lines for the bundle (redacted requestID):
`2026-03-18T14:03:12Z CloudTrail Encrypt principalId=AWS:ROLE/deploy-bot keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-ef01 requestID=xxxx`
`2026-03-18T14:03:13Z CloudTrail GenerateDataKey principalId=AWS:ROLE/deploy-bot keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-ef01 requestID=yyyy`
I'll include the key policy snapshot (artifacts/kms/key-policy-2026-03-01.json).

auditor_jane: Retention: we told the auditor infra logs are retained 365 days. Please include the S3 lifecycle rule screenshot and CloudWatch Logs retention config. Also provide the SIEM ingest configuration that copies CloudTrail to s3://redwood-logs/infra/ and the lifecycle rule name.

kevin_oncall: Screenshots + export: S3 lifecycle rule `retain-365` and CloudWatch Logs group `/aws/cloudtrail/infra` retention = 365. I'll upload PNGs to artifacts/screenshots/retention-365.png and cw-retention-365.png.

samir: Packaging: auditor requires signed manifest + sha256. We'll put everything under s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-18/rbac-change/, include manifest.json listing files, manifest.sha256, and manifest.sig (signed with compliance PGP key). Compliance docs require metadata tags `evidence-type` and `collector`.

compliance-bot: Reminder: evidence must include file-level metadata. Upload docs: `aws s3 cp --metadata evidence-type=rbac-change,collector=eng-security` and add a `packaging/README.md` that maps files to controls. See /policies/compliance/evidence-packaging.md for template. :information_source:

helen: I'll draft the mapping narrative. Draft outline: 1) Summary of change + risk addressed 2) Artifacts list and mapping (SOC2 CC6.4/CC7.1 etc) 3) Evidence of execution (CloudTrail/Deploy logs) 4) KMS usage proof 5) Retention config 6) Packaging & integrity steps.

auditor_jane: Good. Also provide expected reviewer checklist and instructions for verifying signature (PGP key fingerprint included).

kevin_oncall: Will scrub PII and replace emails with user IDs. Also will include presigned S3 links valid 7 days when upload is complete.

samir: Uploads starting now. Files being copied: commit.txt, plan.txt, rolebindings/2026-03-18.yaml, stack-update-event.json, kms-samples.txt, key-policy.json, retention screenshots.

helen: Target EOD (2026-03-19) to upload and mark ready. Once uploaded I'll create manifest and sign with compliance key `0xA1B2C3D4`.

auditor_jane: Timeline ok. Please ping me here when uploaded. Prefer separate small README that lists where each artifact maps to SOC2/ISO controls (explicit control IDs).

kevin_oncall: Uploaded first batch to s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-18/rbac-change/commit.txt and plan.txt. Posting presigned links in thread once all files done.

samir: All artifacts uploaded, created manifest.json and ran `sha256sum` -> manifest.sha256. Manifest signed with compliance PGP and uploaded manifest.sig. Links will be posted.

helen: I added packaging/README.md with mapping to controls and verification steps. Doing final QA on redactions.

auditor_jane: Thanks, will validate once I get links. Please include contact point for any follow-ups (technical vs compliance).

helen: Contact: helen@redwood (technical lead) and compliance@redwood for packaging questions. We will redact actual emails in artifact files, but include contact in bundle metadata as required.

compliance-bot: Checklist complete? Use the uploader tool to set metadata `evidence-type=rbac-change`, `collector=eng-security`, `retention-policy=365d`. :white_check_mark:

helen: Done. Upload complete, presigned links (7d): https://s3.redwood/presign/rbac-change/manifest.json?X... (uploaded). @auditor_jane tagging you.

auditor_jane: Received. I'll start review and post any clarifying Qs. Thanks for quick turnaround.

kevin_oncall: Closing loop: recorded in #compliance-log that artifacts were uploaded and signature verified internally.

helen: Great work team. We'll snapshot this thread into the evidence bundle as evidence-packaging-log. :lock:
